comparison.objective: Remove one tissue from a pop-up box while leaving the next tissue presented.
comparison.physical_skill: Pinch and manipulate coupled deformable sheets without tipping the box or extracting both.
comparison.success_condition: First tissue reaches the tray, second protrudes at least 10 mm while remaining partly inside, box returns to its pose, and grippers clear for 1 second.
comparison.reason: Deformable-sheet separation and presentation are unrelated to rigid damper commissioning and its tool/force-control sequence.
